overview: Built a chatbot for a skin treatment clinic to handle leads coming from Facebook Ads and GoHighLevel.
The chatbot responds to new and existing leads, answers common treatment and pricing questions, qualifies prospects, and guides them toward appointment booking or course enrollment.

blocks.p: I connected the chatbot with GoHighLevel to manage the lead journey from first message to booking.

list: Responds to Facebook Ads leads automatically
Handles leads already stored in the CRM
Qualifies leads based on their requirements
Handles appointment scheduling and follow ups
Uses conversation context to provide relevant responses
Routes leads through the appropriate booking workflow

result: The system gave the clinic a faster and more consistent way to handle incoming leads, reduced repetitive work for staff, and helped move qualified prospects from initial conversation to appointment booking.
The chatbot now works as the clinic’s first point of contact, while the team remains involved when human assistance is needed.
